post.summary: Get cart details (authenticated customer or guest)
post.description: Returns the active cart with items, totals, coupons, shipping/payment method, and addresses. Works for both a logged-in customer and a guest; the cart is always identified by the Bearer token (the customer token, or the guest cart token from POST /api/shop/cart-token). A cart id in the body is ignored. It is a POST (not GET) because reading the cart recalculates totals; the GraphQL equivalent is the `createReadCart` mutation for the same reason. Body may be an empty `{}` for a logged-in customer.

CustomerOrderShipment.description:
Customer Order Shipment API Resource

Standalone API resource for shipments belonging to authenticated customer's orders.
Provides shipment details including tracking numbers, items, addresses, and payment info.
Customer-scoped via order relationship — customers can only access their own shipments.

Relationships:
- order: The parent order
- items: Shipment line items
- shippingAddress: Destination address for the shipment
- billingAddress: Billing address from the order
